preconditions.description: The array length n is between 1 and 2,000,000 inclusive.
The number of coupons m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(coupons) == m and all(1 <= q <= 100000 and 1 <= w <= 100000 for q, w in coupons)
preconditions.description: There are exactly m coupons, each with distinct q and w values between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(set(q for q, w in coupons)) == m
preconditions.description: All coupon values q are distinct.

postconditions.expression: is_valid_beautiful_array(n, selected_values) and total_cost == sum(w for q, w in coupons if q in selected_values)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of costs for a set of values that can form a beautiful array of length n, where a beautiful array requires every pair of distinct values present to appear as adjacent elements at least once.
The output represents the maximum possible cost Sereja can pay, achieved by selecting an optimal subset of coupons that can form a valid beautiful array of size n.
